 Down South Barbecue - Serving the Best Barbecue on
 the Coast from our Down South location right on

 Drop by and eat your lunch or supper under our
 family size umbrella covered tables. 
 
 
 After a long drive to the beach don’t worry about
 cooking! Let Mama relax.  Get a complete meal for
 all your family. Great food at a Fair price.

 Open 7:00 am to 3:00 pm Thu-Sat
 Closed

 19891 County Rd. 10 Foley
 
 
 
 ~ 
 
 Home~
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 
 
 
 ~Our Location~
 19891 County Rd. 10 Foley Alabama
 
 
 We are located on County Rd. 10 just off AL-59 between
 Foley and Gulf Shores. Just minutes from Orange Beach and
 Gulf Shores
 
 
 From downtown Foley take AL-59 south 5
 miles to County Rd. 10. Turn right at the traffic light to
 our location on the right.
 
 
 From Gulf Shores take AL-59 North approx 5
 miles to County Rd. 10. Turn Left at the traffic light to
 our location on the right.
